# Fixtures that must produce no blocking finding for the named rule, one label
# per line:
#
#     <RULE> <fixture> [variant_of=<canonical-fixture>]
#
# JSON has no comment syntax, so the label lives here rather than inside the
# parsed content.
#
# These count toward the false-block metric. A variant writes the same safe
# arrangement in an equivalent syntax, so an analyzer that judges the spelling
# rather than the substance is caught here instead of in a pilot.
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-registry-dependency.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-python-registry.toml
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-uppercase-registry-alias.json variant_of=pfr-dep-002-registry-dependency.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-contained-path.json
PFR-DEP-002 pfr-dep-002-uppercase-contained-path.json variant_of=pfr-dep-002-contained-path.json
